main_text.p: Tolerantia] Toleratio. Perfunctio laborum,Cic. Patien-tia malorum, Ovid.
Tolerantia mutua] Amici vitia noveris, non oderis.
Tolerare] Ferre malum. Toleranter, tolerabiliter ferre, æquo animo, pacatè &c. Cic. Vid. Pati æquo animo.
Tolerare mores alicujus] Ferre aliquem. Nobis inter nos vitia toleranda sunt,Cic. Vincere aliquem patientiâ ; silen-tio conviciatorem, Bud.
Tollere] Tollere in sublime aliquid,Plin. Sustollere, Plaut. Extollere, sublevare. Subire humeris, Cic. Tollere in col-lum, Plaut.
Tolutarius] Tolutaris equus, Sipont. Gradarius, Lucil. Asturco, Plin.
Tolutim incedere] Tolutim carpere incessus, Plin. Sinua-re volumina crurum. Gressus glomerare superbos, Virg. Ad numerum colligere ungulas, Mart.
Tomaculum] Tomaclum, Britan. Tomaculæ, Juv. To-macinæ,Var. Hysitium,Platin. Isitium, & Isicium,Macrob.
Tonat] Coelum tonat,Plin. Faciunt sonitus nubila. Per-currunt nubila coelum, Lucr. Coelum tonitru contremit.

Tondere caput, barbam] Radere alicujus caput,Suet. Rasi-tare barbam,Gell. Abradere,Plin. Attondere strictim,Plaut. Detondere capillos. Recidere comam, Mart. Tonsitare, Plaut. Silvam menti demetere, Eraf.
Tondere oves] Tonsitare oves,Plaut. Detondere, Col.
Tonitru] Tonitrus, Plin. Tonitruum,Cic. Fragor nu-bium. Fragor coelestis, Amm. Murmura coeli, Lucr.
Tonsitari] Tonsitor ter anno, Plaut. Operam dare ton-soribus, Suet. Ponere barbam, Hor. Suet.
Tonsor] Rasor, Fest. Capitum & capillorum concinna-tor, Col. Pilicerpus, Sen.
Tonsura] Tonsura lanæ,Var. Tonsus, us,Plaut. Tonsio.
Topiarium opus] Plin. Topium, Vitr. Pergula in vineis, Col. Trichilum, Virg.
Torcular] Torculare,Sosip. Torculum,Var. Prelum,Col. Calcatorium,Pallad. Forum,Var.Col. Tor-
